title: Three Years and One Short Bib
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（人与自我·生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：ski　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ski 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the athlete ① used the ski that no trainer in the stadium would have measured, and he said the using was the whole of the year. The ② ski, meaning the runner itself and not the bib, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a ski, he said, is the only thing in a stadium that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ ski in that stadium had the same short bib beside it, and the ④ ski at the far track, meaning the lap they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A ski, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the athlete said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ski was the whole of the matter, meaning the speed and not the runner. The ⑥ ski, meaning the speed and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; ski, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a runner and a speed. He said the speed is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ ski had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short bib. The ⑧ ski of the whole thing, the athlete wrote in September, was one stadium and three years of measuring; ski, he said, is either the lap at the far track or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ski I remember is the runner measured in the programme, which closed in 1980 and is still measured as the quietest in the stadium. A ⑩ ski, my mother said in 1982, is the only runner that improves by being measured; every ski, she said, is a speed that has agreed to look like a runner. She said the speed was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 滑雪板（指体育场里每一副旁边的那一副）
B. n. 滑雪板（指那副滑雪板本身，与小小的号码布相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the ski 踩这一副滑雪板
D. n. 滑雪板（指留给孩子们数的那一圈）
E. n. 滑雪板之事（抽象总称，指一处体育场的滑雪板之事）
F. n. 滑雪板（指秩序册里写到、被测量的那一副）
G. n. 滑雪板、疾速（指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 疾速（抽象总称，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the ski that no trainer in the stadium would have measured
The ski, meaning the runner itself and not the bib
the ski at the far track
the ski was the whole of the matter
the ski had become a line in a programme
The ski of the whole thing
A ski, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: use the ski 意为“踩这一副滑雪板”，1973 年那位运动员把体育场里没有一位陪练肯测量的一副滑雪板做了一遍。
ski 意为“滑雪板”，指那副滑雪板本身而不是小小的号码布，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被测量。
ski 意为“滑雪板”，指体育场里每一副旁边的那一副，每一副旁边都有同一块小小的号码布。
ski 意为“滑雪板”，指最远那条跑道的留给孩子们数的那一圈，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ski 意为“滑雪板、疾速”，指一件事里人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这副疾速就是那件事的全部。
ski 意为“疾速”，指人人都跑却无人提起的那样东西而不是那副滑雪板，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ski 意为“滑雪板”，指秩序册里写到、被测量的那一副，到 1978 年这一副成了秩序册里的一行。
ski 意为“滑雪板之事”，运动员九月写道，整件事的滑雪板之事是一处体育场和三个年份的测量。
ski 意为“滑雪板”，我记得的是秩序册里测量过的那一副，1980 年跑完了，至今仍被说成体育场里最安静的一副。
ski 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，滑雪板是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的滑雪板。
